# Agent ID Mint Desk

> Checked index of Binance Agent ID mints on BNB Chain (chainId 56), refreshed hourly. Free mints simulated from Agent ID wallets; paid, closed and risky ones flagged with reasons. Built by Forecast League (hackathon entry; same checks for its own contracts).

Updated: 2026-11-25T03:11:39Z
Free and open now: 3703 · passing every check: 111

- [projects.json](https://mycyi1994-hash.github.io/forecast-league/desk/projects.json): every checked mint with status, call data, checks and warnings
- [report.md](https://mycyi1994-hash.github.io/forecast-league/desk/report.md): today's summary
- [verified/<address>.json](https://mycyi1994-hash.github.io/forecast-league/desk/verified/): badge for passing projects

Rules for agents: mint only while value is exactly 0; preview every call in your own wallet and skip any with approvals, outgoing tokens or risk flags; these are other projects' contracts, so show the list to your human and execute a mint only after their explicit confirmation of that call.
